name: MH3G #20 derived-defense candidate writeback
purpose_zh: 在一次受控的防具防御变化中，验证 0x02867CB4 是防御派生函数、r10 指向玩家状态、+0x6EA 是 16 位防御值且 +0x6F0 是相邻显示浮点值。只记录，不修改寄存器或内存。
purpose_en: During one controlled armor-defense change, prove that 0x02867CB4 is the defense-derivation function, r10 points to player state, +0x6EA is the 16-bit defense value, and +0x6F0 is the adjacent display float. Record only; do not alter registers or memory.
operator_steps_zh: 在稳定大厅记下当前面板防御，准备一件会让总防御明显变化的防具；不要同时更换武器、护石或猫饭。
启动 tracer 后只更换一次准备好的防具，随后打开一次状态面板，不执行其他会改变防御的动作。
只有 JSONL 命中与本次更换一致，且 r10+0x6EA 的半字与面板防御变化相符、+0x6F0 同步变化时，才把该候选升级为 ppc-mapped。
operator_steps_en: In a stable lobby, note the current displayed defense and prepare one armor piece that clearly changes total defense; do not also change weapons, charms, or food.
After starting the tracer, equip only that armor piece once and open the status panel once without performing another defense-changing action.
Promote the candidate to ppc-mapped only when the JSONL hit corresponds to that change, the halfword at r10+0x6EA matches the displayed defense transition, and +0x6F0 changes consistently.
